blocks.html: And in order to attain it the more conveniently, he resolved to inquire and inform himself, as warily as he could, from the said Pivol, Guilher [the print here spells them Puiol, Quillet], and other familiar friends and neighbours, of the condition of the said Martin Guerre: of his father, wife, sisters, uncle and other kinsfolk; together with what the same Martin [was wont to] say and do before going away [unclear: the French has no verb between Martin and dire].
